usage.background: Warm Ivory (#FDFBF7) and White (#FFFFFF) for primary surfaces. Deep Navy (#0A1128) for high-contrast sections (e.g., footer, premium hero overlay).
usage.text: Deep Navy on light backgrounds, Warm Ivory on dark backgrounds.
usage.cta: Champagne Gold (#D4AF37) for premium primary actions (Book Now) only. Deep Navy for secondary buttons.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Optical Clarity Glassmorphism for sticky nav and mobile CTA: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-[#0A1128]/70 (dark) with 1px delicate inner border.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Elegant ambient shadows: shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(10,17,40,0.08)]. Avoid harsh drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Soft radius: rounded-2xl or rounded-3xl for cards. Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for all buttons.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-deep_navy/5 for light cards to ground them.

grids_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-12, p-16, p-24, p-32. The layout must feel like a luxury resort brochure with ample breathing room.
grids_layouts.structure: Bento grids for features (Standard vs Deluxe vs Fresh Start comparison). Asymmetric layouts for marketing storytelling.
grids_layouts.alignment: Left-align dense text, forms, and package details. Center-align only for deliberate architectural symmetry in hero or interstitials.

motion.interactions: Smooth elevation on hover (-translate-y-1 + shadow increase). Button ripple, subtle parallax on background images, elegant page fade transitions.
motion.booking_flow: Smooth step-by-step progress reveals, accordion for FAQs, skeleton loading for price summary sidebar.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full), large padding (px-8 py-4). Primary: Champagne Gold or Deep Navy background. Hover: smooth elevation and slight brightness adjustment.
components.cards: Subtle border, soft radius, flat background (White) on Warm Ivory canvas. No heavy shadows by default.
components.navigation: Sticky glassmorphism header, z-50. Must have visible nav links on desktop, primary Book Now CTA. No completely transparent headers.
components.booking_form: Multi-step luxury flow. Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, and Calendar components but HEAVILY customize them to remove the 'Vercel-look'. Use Champagne Gold/Deep Navy focus rings. Live price summary sidebar.
components.trust_indicators: Testimonials, guarantees, insurance/bonded messaging integrated elegantly. No fake reviews.

image_urls.description: Large luxury bright kitchen with marble island and white cabinets
Modern luxury bathroom with marble vanity
Clean hotel style bedroom with bright linens

media.guidelines: Photography MUST be premium realistic photos of bright homes, luxury spaces, and professional cleaners. NO cartoons, NO fake sparkles, NO cheap stock photography.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text. Champagne Gold text on White requires careful handling or text-shadow.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='book-now-button').
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion via Tailwind media queries.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing layouts. Avoid standard Shadcn Cards/Sections for creative layouts.
Use Shadcn heavily for the multi-step booking flow (forms, inputs, dropdowns, calendar, dialogs). Customize them to remove the Vercel look.
Do NOT use HTML input type='date', use Shadcn Calendar.
Position as a luxury hospitality experience. Never mention 'hourly' pricing. Enforce FLAT pricing (Residential $119-$479, Deep Cleaning from $279, Airbnb $79-$139).
Service area is strictly Regina, Saskatchewan.
No em dashes, no inflated language, no rule-of-three cadence in copy.
Do not put transparent backgrounds behind text or in the header. Use glassmorphism or solid fills.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component is located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
